svg.aria-label: Review in one tap. The draft card offers Approve and save, Reject, and chips for priority and intent. Tapping the priority chip lets you pick High, Medium or Low, and that choice is kept through redrafts. After approval the card reads Saved to Notion, 2 tasks, with Open in Notion and Undo buttons.
